# Apex SEO /rent proxy
#
# Vercel rewrites (see vercel.json) reverse-proxy:
#   /rent/*  →  https://app.evorios.com/__seo/rent/*
#   /assets/*, /api/* (needed for the proxied SPA shell)
#
# Browser URL stays https://evorios.com/rent/... and returns 200.
# Canonical + sitemap live on this domain only.
# Keep sitemap.xml in sync with AllByRent scripts/seo/evorios-apex-sitemap.xml
# (regenerated by `npm run seo:sitemap` in the app repo).
